limitations: PRIDE lists LTQ Orbitrap XL; the RAW headers of the SLAP1 runs say LTQ Orbitrap Velos, which is used.
The nature of the light control (e.g. empty vector) is not stated; it is encoded as 'control (no SLAP-Flag)'.
The fractionation (SDS-PAGE slices) is inferred from per-fraction protein molecular weight; the PRIDE protocol does not mention it and refers to Naudin et al. 2014 (not open access).

sdrf-tools reconcile reports Mus musculus as the only record organism (false positive: project.json organisms = NEWT:9606 Homo sapiens; the mouse SLAP bait sequence file is the likely trigger) and Trypsin as unsupported (it is the MaxQuant search enzyme).
The MaxQuant search enzyme was Trypsin/P; annotated as Trypsin.
Precursor tolerance 4.5 ppm is the MaxQuant default (not recorded in parameters.txt); observed mass errors fit it (99th percentile 4.22 ppm per independent review).
